get.summary: Start a browser login
get.description:
Required role: none.

Redirects to `/auth/{type}`, which redirects to the identity provider. After the user logs in, the browser is redirected to `redirect_uri` with an `access_token` (or an `error`) query parameter.

post.summary: Get a new token with the user's current role
post.description:
Required role: none.

Send the current token. Use this after a user's role changes so they don't have to log in again. The new token expires when the current one would have.

get.summary: Log in as the guest user, if the server allows guests

401.description: Wrong password, or the server doesn't allow the root user

post.summary: Log in as the root user, if the server allows it

post.description:
Required role: none.

For clients that can't open a browser themselves, such as the CLI. Show the user `verification_uri` and `user_code` (or `verification_uri_complete`), then poll `POST /auth/device/token` every `interval` seconds.

400.description: The login isn't finished, or has expired

post.summary: Get the token for a device login
post.description:
Required role: none.

Poll this until the user has logged in. Until then it responds with status 400 and an `error` of `authorization_pending`, or `slow_down` if polled too often. An `error` of `expired_token` means the login has expired.

post.description:
Required role: user or higher.

All edits to annotations, assemblies, and users are made by submitting changes. The server validates and applies the change, saves it to the change log, and broadcasts it to other connected clients.

Each type of change also requires a role:

| Change type | Required role |
| --- | --- |
| `AddAssemblyAliasesChange` | user or higher |
| `AddAssemblyAndFeaturesFromFileChange` | admin |
| `AddAssemblyFromExternalChange` | user or higher |
| `AddAssemblyFromFileChange` | admin |
| `AddFeatureChange` | user or higher |
| `AddFeaturesFromFileChange` | admin |
| `AddRefSeqAliasesChange` | admin |
| `AddUserChange` | admin |
| `DeleteAssemblyChange` | admin |
| `DeleteFeatureChange` | user or higher |
| `DeleteUserChange` | admin |
| `FeatureAttributeChange` | user or higher |
| `ImportJBrowseConfigChange` | user or higher |
| `LocationEndChange` | user or higher |
| `LocationStartChange` | user or higher |
| `MergeExonsChange` | user or higher |
| `MergeTranscriptsChange` | user or higher |
| `SplitExonChange` | user or higher |
| `StrandChange` | user or higher |
| `TypeChange` | user or higher |
| `UndoMergeExonsChange` | user or higher |
| `UndoMergeTranscriptsChange` | user or higher |
| `UndoSplitExonChange` | user or higher |
| `UserChange` | admin |

info.title: Apollo Collaboration Server
info.description: The REST API of the Apollo collaboration server. Most endpoints need a token in an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

tags.name: Changes
tags.description: Submit changes and read the change log

tags.name: Checks
tags.description: Automated checks on features, such as for valid CDSs

baseUrl.description: The server's URL, as set in its URL configuration

checks.description: IDs of the checks to run on this assembly

topLevel.description: Return the top-level features that contain the requested features

token.description: JWT to send in the `Authorization: Bearer` header

password.description: The root user's password, set with ROOT_USER_PASSWORD

type.description: Login type to use, one of the names from `GET /auth/types`

user_code.description: Code for the user to confirm, e.g. `BCDF-GHJK`

verification_uri.description: Page where the user enters the code and logs in

assembly.description: Assembly ID, for changes to an assembly or its features

changedIds.description: IDs of the features this change modifies, for feature changes
